frames.caption: 01 · CAPACITY — What burden leaves the founder?. Name the decisions, relationships, records, calendars, risks, and emotional labor the partner carries. Replace “business side” with observable work and consequences.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what burden leaves the founder? within The Business Partner Beside the Name.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · AUTHORITY — What may each person decide?. Write decision rights as verb plus object, threshold, required consultation, override, evidence, and appeal. Separate custom from enforceable authority.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what may each person decide? within The Business Partner Beside the Name.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · ECONOMICS — How are value and downside shared?. Map equity, votes, salary, royalty, bonus, expenses, guarantees, vesting, transfer, dilution, information, and exit separately. Public filings are examples, not templates.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping how are value and downside shared? within The Business Partner Beside the Name.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: 04 · BREAK — What happens when alignment ends?. Run deadlock, incapacity, departure, nonperformance, acquisition, founder conflict, and reputational crisis through the actual governance and contract records with qualified counsel.

frames.caption: Celebrating the operational partner can obscure staff, workers, advisers, and communities who also carry the institution. Conversely, romanticizing founder chemistry can hide unequal economics or undocumented authority. Precision makes collaboration visible without pretending harmony.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for The Business Partner Beside the Name.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery

frames.caption: Attach corporate, contract, account, and practice evidence separately.
